articles.original_title: Federal government doubles its commitment to improving the home of Canadian art
articles.original_summary: The McMichael Canadian Art Collection in Kleinburg is remaking the home of Canadian art. The project will transform and expand the McMichael facility, making it a sustainable premier cultural centre and a destination for the preservation and display of more than 8,000 works of art by Canadian and Indigenous artists. The renewed McMichael will also offer a more efficient and engaging platform for the gallery’s landmark exhibitions and educational programs, serving the local community – and the country as a whole – as never before.

articles.original_title: Federal government doubles its commitment to improving the home of Canadian art
articles.original_summary: The McMichael Canadian Art Collection in Kleinburg is remaking the home of Canadian art. The project will transform and expand the McMichael facility, making it a sustainable premier cultural centre and a destination for the preservation and display of more than 8,000 works of art by Canadian and Indigenous artists. The renewed McMichael will also offer a more efficient and engaging platform for the gallery’s landmark exhibitions and educational programs, serving the local community – and the country as a whole – as never before.
